provenance.procedure: ReadProcessMemory only; no writes, inputs, thread APIs, debugger attachment, or process suspension

x87_control_word.explanation: This is the specified memory global, not an observed hardware register. The caller must provide original-code evidence for the address.

limitations: Snapshots are sequential reads and are not atomic. Identity checks detect some concurrent changes but do not prove no race or torn double read.
All 100 numeric slots are captured, including inactive slots. Their bytes are observations of this allocation, not universal constructor defaults.
Raw little-endian IEEE-754 hex is authoritative. Decimal value_text is display only and may include NaN/Infinity.
The reader does not claim that a stored control-word global equals a thread's current hardware control word.
